status_policy.candidate: passes current structural and safety extraction gate; still C; modern_extension rows remain non-runtime until separately verified
status_policy.deferred: timing material; record only, never activate dates without explicit timing workflow
status_policy.quarantined: judgment-looking span preserved for audit but blocked by safety, sensational, case, CTA, mixed-system or quality gate
status_policy.excluded_no_reusable_judgment: article accounted for, but no structured condition-mechanism judgment survived extraction
status_policy.empty_body_direct_article_link: 正文为空但保留了直接文章链接；抽样访问触发微信验证时停止，不绕过
status_policy.empty_body_album_link: 正文为空但保留了合集链接；可在公开合集页按分页继续抓取
status_policy.empty_body_other_link: 正文为空且链接类型未列入直接文章/合集

promotion_gate: No promotion without source locator, independent support, counterexample, Chart Facts regression and safety gate.
